question: How does a classifier selected on the original training data perform on the supplied FR/NFR labels of the CPN and ePurse sections?
external_selection: All eligible CPN and ePurse records after documented duplicate and overlap checks. No selection by predictions or model performance.
retained_label_rule: Use the published Type value without manual relabelling.
training: Keep the original stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). Fit only on its 4748 training rows.
validation: Five identical stratified folds inside the training data; shuffle=True, random_state=42. Fit TF-IDF separately in every fold.
model_selection: Highest mean training-only macro F1 across three fixed configurations. Test sets do not decide the selected model.
features: Default TF-IDF word unigrams, lowercase=True, no stop words, L2 normalization, smoothed IDF. Only the requirement text is a feature.
evaluation: Accuracy, macro precision, macro recall, macro F1, class metrics and confusion matrices on the original holdout and pooled external data. Report the two external projects separately as well.
scope: A limited two-specification external case study with many security requirements. No universal generalisation or time-saving claim.
